initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 28/40 − 48/60 = −0.10. Arithmetic verification does not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R293-2 to assess whether the causal effect is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 28/40 − 48/60 = −0.10. R293-2 supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the missing counterfactual risks. Therefore, the average causal risk difference is not uniquely identified; arithmetic verification does not establish causal identification.
